name: Mautic Typo3
headline: mautic-typo3: Enhance Marketing Automation
short_description: Add-on TYPO3 extension that enhances the "EXT:marketing_automation" TYPO3 extension by connecting it to the Mautic Marketing Automation platform: Determine "Persona" from Mautic segments. Also provides additional services e.g. language synchronisation between Mautic and TYPO3.
author: mautic

sections.overview: The mautic-typo3 skill is an essential add-on for developers and marketing teams looking to enhance their marketing automation capabilities. By integrating the TYPO3 extension 'EXT:marketing_automation' with the Mautic Marketing Automation platform, this skill allows users to determine 'Persona' from Mautic segments seamlessly. Additionally, it offers language synchronization between Mautic and TYPO3, ensuring that your marketing messages are consistent and relevant across different languages and segments. One of the key benefits of the mautic-typo3 skill is its ability to streamline workflows, allowing teams to focus on strategic marketing initiatives rather than manual data handling. While the exact time savings are currently unknown, the implementation time is approximately 30 minutes, making it a quick and efficient addition to your marketing stack. This skill is particularly valuable for product managers and AI practitioners who need to ensure that their marketing efforts are data-driven and personalized. Developers and marketing professionals in organizations utilizing TYPO3 and Mautic will find this skill particularly beneficial. It is designed for those who are familiar with intermediate-level technical implementations and are looking to enhance their marketing automation strategies. Practical use cases include automating email campaigns based on user behavior tracked in Mautic, and ensuring that multilingual content is delivered effectively to diverse audiences. The mautic-typo3 skill fits seamlessly into AI-first workflows by enabling automated decision-making based on user segments and personas. As businesses increasingly rely on AI automation to optimize their marketing efforts, this skill provides a crucial link between content management systems and marketing automation platforms. With its moderate complexity and straightforward implementation, it is an ideal choice for teams looking to leverage AI-driven insights to improve their marketing outcomes.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/mautic/mautic-typo3`
1. Download the mautic-typo3 extension from the TYPO3 Extension Repository.
2. Install it via the Extension Manager in your TYPO3 backend.
3. Clear the cache to ensure all changes are applied.
